author: harness:claude-code

patch.value: Model capture is inert in practice: zero of 35,103 recorded entries carry a model, because the declared signal for the primary harness is an environment variable that harness does not set

The recorded entry format carries agent_model and agent_model_source, the detection layer resolves a model candidate, and history writes the field when a candidate exists. All of that shipped. What did not ship is a working signal for the harness that actually drives this repository. The built-in descriptor for claude-code declares model_environment_keys of ANTHROPIC_MODEL and CLAUDE_MODEL. Neither is present in a live Claude Code session; the environment exposes CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT, CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH, CLAUDE_PID and CLAUDE_EFFORT, and no model variable at all. The consequence is measurable rather than theoretical: scanning all 2,085 history streams and 35,103 recorded entries in this workspace returns zero entries carrying agent_model. Harness detection itself works correctly and is recorded on every entry as detected. So the capability reads as delivered on every surface — the type declares it, the detector resolves it, the writer persists it — and produces nothing, and no gate or check notices. Per-model attribution analytics, which depend entirely on this field, would return empty results that are indistinguishable from a fleet in which every agent happens to be unattributed.

The declared signals for each supported harness are validated against what that harness actually exposes, and a signal that cannot fire is either corrected or recorded as unavailable rather than left declared; For harnesses that expose no model variable, an alternative resolution path is defined — client handshake metadata, invocation argument, or explicit configuration — so the field can be populated without the agent naming itself; A check reports the proportion of recorded entries carrying a model, per harness, so an inert signal is visible instead of silent; The check fails when a harness that declares a model signal records no model across a window of mutations, which is the condition that exists today; Model capture is exercised end to end for at least one harness in the test suite, asserting the recorded entry rather than the detector's return value; Documentation states which harnesses currently yield a model and which do not, so the analytics that consume it can distinguish absent from unattributed
Make the recorded model a fact that is either present or explicitly known to be unavailable, never silently missing

Recording which model acted is a stated requirement for this tracker, and the mechanism has been treated as delivered since it shipped. It has never once produced a value. Everything built on per-model attribution is currently building on an empty column.
Turns model provenance from a declared capability into a measured one, and unblocks per-model attribution analytics which cannot function without it
Recorded entries carry the acting model wherever the harness can supply it, and the coverage is reported rather than assumed
Every mutation written while the signal is inert is a permanently unattributable entry, and this workspace has already written 35,103 of them

message: File inert model capture: 0 of 35,103 entries carry agent_model; claude-code descriptor declares ANTHROPIC_MODEL/CLAUDE_MODEL, neither of which the harness sets

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Re-measured 2026-07-28 across the full corpus, 40,353 entries. Two things changed since this item was written and one scoping conclusion is now firm.

What SHIPPED: entries now carry an agent_provenance object, present on 807 entries, and it holds the model slot plus an effort sub-object. Effort capture WORKS - my own entries this session read agent_provenance.effort = {value: "xhigh", source: "environment"}, resolved from CLAUDE_EFFORT. agent_instance is also live on 5,108 entries. So the plumbing this item needed is complete: there is a field, it is populated for a sibling dimension, and the entry shape is right.

What has NOT changed: agent_model and agent_provenance.model are null on 40,353 of 40,353 entries. Not one recorded entry in the history of this workspace carries a model. Harness detection meanwhile is healthy - agent_harness is populated on 6,143 entries across three distinct harnesses, claude-code 4,350, codex 1,638, opencode 155.

The scoping conclusion, which changes what the fix is: the model is NOT obtainable from the environment on this harness. A live dump of the claude-code process environment shows exactly these keys - CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT, CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_EFFORT, CLAUDE_PID. There is no ANTHROPIC_MODEL, no CLAUDE_MODEL, and no other key naming a model. Adding more spellings to model_environment_keys therefore cannot fix this, because the value being looked for is not published to the environment at all.

So the remaining work is to choose a different SOURCE, not a different key. The options worth weighing at fix time: derive it from the harness's own version or session metadata reachable via CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH, accept an explicit configured value, or let the SDK caller supply it and record the source honestly as asserted rather than detected. Whichever is chosen, effort already demonstrates the right pattern - it records both a value and a source, so a supplied model can be distinguished from a detected one without weakening the provenance guarantee.

Note the effort precedent also settles the companion question on the descriptor-extensibility item: a dimension outside the original three-key schema was added and is populating correctly, so the schema is no longer the blocker.

value.text:
Closed-item conformance check 2026-07-31. Recorded here so the closed record does not continue to read as if practical model capture were achieved; no reopen is proposed, because the shipped channels and the shipped analysis both match this item's resolution text.

This item's title states the condition as zero of 35,103 recorded entries carrying a model. Measured today over 44,408 entries: 2,814 carry a model key and all 2,814 are explicit nulls, so observed model count corpus-wide is still zero, including every entry written in the four days since this closed. The actual_result recorded here - 'Installed CLI history persisted gpt-5.6-sol with override source' - is reproducible and is the override channel, which requires PM_AGENT_MODEL to be set by hand. The automatic detection channels have not produced an observation on any real entry.

The live gap is tracked by the open pm-ffz0a9, which now carries this measurement plus a same-session probe showing effort resolving from CLAUDE_EFFORT while model resolves to an explicit null in the same entry. Two adjacent mechanism defects found the same day: pm-9wbiye (explicit-unavailable is written for the model dimension only) and pm-1wiugq (the coverage analyzer this item delivered has no consumer outside its own unit test, so the inert condition it detects has never been reported).
